name: Leapfrog
summary: A loading spinner where the last dot leaps over the gap in the ring and lands in front
about: Nine dots sit in a ring of twelve places. Every third of a second the tail dot crouches, leaps outwards over the empty gap and squashes down in front of the head, with a dust ring where it lands. It comes with speed and pause controls and a simulated load that ends in a check mark.
how: Watch the tail dot crouch, stretch, leap over the gap and land with a squash
Pick Calm, Normal or Quick to change how often the dots hop, or pause them
Press Simulate a load to see the spinner work while a progress bar fills
When loading finishes the dots wind up, gather in the middle and turn into a check
Press Run it again and the dots spring back out to their places
